name: wheel–rail rolling noise
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 轮轨滚动接触激励引起的噪声。
usage_overview: 作为轮轨噪声预测与极值响应估计的研究对象，关注轮轨粗糙度激发结构振动后产生的噪声；在计入车轮、钢轨和轨道板的模型中，考察各结构的噪声贡献。

complete_examples.text: Page 11 of 22 This synthetic model is called the time-varying wheel–rail rolling noise (TVWRRN) prediction model.
Consequently, this method can be applied to predict the time dependent extremum of wheel–rail rolling noise.

P062.title: A novel method for extremum response estimation of wheel–rail rolling noise by the development of moving pseudo-excitation method
